name: Koinonia Link
author: Randy Breland

sections.description:
Koinonia Link is an all-in-one ministry tool designed to help churches bridge the gap between Sunday morning and the rest of the week. Built for 2026 ministry needs, it provides a seamless “First Impressions” workflow and a robust Guest CRM that ensures no one falls through the cracks.

Unlike standalone ChMS platforms, Koinonia Link lives inside your website, giving you 100% ownership of your data and a unified experience for your staff and congregation.

Key Features include:
* Plan Your Visit Block: A high-conversion Gutenberg block for guests to pre-register.
* Guest CRM: Unlimited guest profiles with interaction history and spiritual milestones.
* Digital Connection Card: A mobile-first registration page optimized for QR code use.
* Privacy & Ethics First: Built-in tools for data anonymization and GDPR compliance.
* Developer Friendly: Dozens of hooks and filters for deep customization.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the koinonia-link folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘Koinonia Link’ menu in the admin sidebar to begin setup.
  4. Add the ‘Plan Your Visit’ block to any page using the Gutenberg editor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store data on external servers?

No. Koinonia Link is self-hosted. All your guest data and pastoral notes stay on your private WordPress database.

Is it compatible with my theme?

Yes. We use standard WordPress Custom Post Types and Gutenberg blocks, making it compatible with all modern block-based and classic themes.
